definitions.explanation: A physically large ocean or sea wave.
A powerful force or trend that sweeps through, used metaphorically for social, economic, or emotional upheaval.

examples.japanese: {大波|おおなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大波|おおなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Large waves are rising in the sea because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦サーファー→サーファー：28767_saafaa⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大波|おおなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}ろう→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{沖|おき}→沖：02144_oki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The surfers headed offshore to ride the big waves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大波|おおなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せている→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧。
examples.english: A great wave of change is sweeping in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大波|おおなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}→中小企業：24117_chuushoukigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み{込|こ}んだ→飲み込む：04403_nomikomu⟧。
examples.english: The wave of recession engulfed small and medium enterprises.

examples.japanese: ⟦グローバル{化|か}→グローバル化：30240_guroobaruka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大波|おおなみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The great wave of globalization had a major impact on Japanese industry as well.

notes:
{大波|おおなみ} literally means "big wave" ({大|おお} + ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧) but is also widely used figuratively for powerful trends or forces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大波|おおなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: large waves rise
- {大波|おおなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: ride a big wave; ride a wave (of change)
- {大波|おおなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧: a great wave surges in
- {大波|おおなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}まれる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: be swallowed by a big wave
- {大波|おおなみ}{小波|こなみ}: ups and downs; rough patches and calm ones

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{荒波|あらなみ}→荒波：14026_aranami⟧: rough waves; stormy seas — emphasizes roughness and turbulence rather than size
- ⟦{高波|たかなみ}→高波：19938_takanami⟧: high wave — often used in weather warnings for dangerously high surf
- ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧: tsunami — a seismic sea wave, distinct from ordinary large waves
